prompt: How many web orders did Voltmarkt take on each day of the week in 2025, by Amsterdam time? Use the orders table and keep the orders with channel 'web'. order_ts holds the time of the order in UTC: turn it into Amsterdam time first, then take the weekday, and keep the orders whose Amsterdam date is in 2025. Return two columns, in this order: iso_weekday, the ISO day number from 1 for Monday to 7 for Sunday, and orders, the number of web orders. Return one row for each day of the week. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, write the calculated column iso_weekday: the ISO weekday number of each web order in Amsterdam time.
isodow counts Monday as 1 and Sunday as 7, while dayofweek counts Sunday as 0. Convert order_ts to Amsterdam time first, in SELECT and in WHERE, so late-evening orders land on the right day.
why_this_works: isodow on the Amsterdam time gives each web order the weekday of the Amsterdam clock, so an order at 23:30 UTC on a Sunday counts on Monday.
